bio: The MMA franchise returns with overhauled clinch and ground striking, a deeper career mode, and a roster spanning the modern UFC. Aimed squarely at fans who want the most authentic octagon sim on console.

A ground-up remake of the beloved pirate chapter. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway with rebuilt naval combat, modernised stealth, and a fully remastered open world of islands, forts and ghostly shipwrecks.

The first mainline Halo ever to land on PlayStation — an Unreal Engine 5 remake of Combat Evolved's campaign with 4K visuals, nine extra weapons, and a brand-new three-mission prologue, Operation: METEORITE.
A gorgeous 4-vs-4 tag-team Marvel brawler from the Guilty Gear studio. Build a squad from 20 launch heroes and villains, chain tag combos, and switch fighters mid-fight in flashy, combo-heavy bouts.
A turn-based tactics game in the XCOM mould set in the Clone Wars era. Lead a customisable squad of misfits, manage cover and abilities, and build bonds between your soldiers across a galaxy at war.

t: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
bio: The second wave of classic Metal Gear remasters, bundling later entries in the saga with extras and quality-of-life touches — essential preservation for stealth-action fans catching up on Kojima's run.

A new chapter in the acclaimed plague-ravaged saga of Amicia and Hugo. Expect the series' signature mix of stealth, light-and-rats puzzling, and gut-punch storytelling against a beautiful, brutal medieval France.

A dark-fantasy vampire RPG from ex-Witcher 3 leads. Play a man caught between human and vampire as a literal day/night clock shapes a non-linear story — your hours are limited, and every choice spends them.

“Kung-fu-punk” action at a blistering pace. As the assassin Soul, weave together lethal weapon styles in fluid, deeply technical combat across a striking world blending wuxia myth with steampunk machinery.

Insomniac's brutal, mature take on Logan. A more savage, grounded combat system leans into berserker rage and healing-factor punishment as Wolverine hunts answers about his past. The marquee PS5 exclusive of the year.
The open-world survival MMO finally arrives on PS5. Survive Arrakis itself — manage water, dodge sandworms and storms, harvest spice, and build power in a shared, faction-driven Dune sandbox.
The long-awaited follow-up to Control. Return to Remedy's reality-warping universe with telekinetic combat, shifting brutalist architecture and the studio's trademark weird, layered storytelling.
A fresh, experimental entry in the Silent Hill universe from the makers of Stories Untold. Light on details, heavy on dread — psychological horror that promises to play with form as much as fear.
Capcom revives its samurai-horror series. Set in a haunted Edo-era Japan, channel the Oni Gauntlet to absorb demon souls and master tense, weighty katana duels against the Genma.
A polished remaster of the entry that defined the one-vs-thousands musou formula, bundling its expansions. Comfort-food carnage across the Three Kingdoms for series veterans and the curious alike.
An isometric sci-fi survival-horror set in a doomed deep-space facility. Atmosphere-first dread, scarce resources, and a creeping unknown lurking just beyond the edge of the light.
High-G arcade dogfighting returns. Expect operatic skies, a melodramatic war story, dozens of jets and that unmistakable Ace Combat thrill of threading missiles through canyon walls at Mach speed.

Arcade podracing for a new generation. Tear through canyons and city circuits, sabotage rivals, and chase a championship under the thumb of a corrupt league champion in a scrappy, high-speed Star Wars racer.
The full 1.0 launch of Moon Studios' hand-painted action-RPG, arriving on PS5. Brutal, deliberate combat meets gorgeous Ori-pedigree art and a grim story of plague, faith and a kingdom on the brink.
A new Castlevania arriving just in time for Halloween. The Belmont whip cracks again through a gothic castle of the night — early details are scarce, but the bloodline's curse is back.
A sequel to the breezy, co-op-friendly dungeon crawler. Loot-driven action in the blocky Minecraft world, built for couch or online play with friends and a low barrier to entry.

The big one. Rockstar returns to a neon-soaked, modern Vice City in the state of Leonida, following Jason and Lucia in a sprawling open world widely expected to be one of the largest entertainment launches ever.
From the Yakuza/Like a Dragon team, a stylish period crime drama spanning decades of modern Japan. Brawl, charm and sing your way through a sprawling tale of people with nowhere left to go.
Lara Croft's next adventure revisits her roots, from the Peru Lost Valley outward, in a return to classic tomb-raiding: puzzle-filled ruins, deadly traps and lost-civilisation mystery.
A full remake of the cult JRPG. Balance high-school life and a murder mystery inside the eerie TV world, building bonds by day and battling Shadows by night, rebuilt with modern visuals and systems.

Playground's reboot of the British fantasy series — now confirmed for PS5. A witty, fairy-tale Albion of moral choice, where a self-styled hero's actions ripple across a living, storybook world. Jack of Blades returns.

The next chapter of the post-apocalyptic shooter saga. Descend back into the irradiated tunnels and ruined surface of Moscow for tense, survival-flavoured gunplay, scarce ammo and creeping atmosphere.

The finale of the Remake trilogy. Cloud and company's journey reaches its climax — expect the series' lavish production, evolved action-RPG combat, and the emotional payoff fans have waited a generation for.
Team Ninja's Three-Kingdoms soulslike returns. Parry-heavy, aggressive combat and morale-driven systems set against a dark, demon-haunted retelling of ancient Chinese history.
A new horror title unveiled during the June 2026 Xbox Showcase, confirmed for PS5. Early footage leans into unsettling cult imagery and dread — one to keep an eye on as details emerge.
The open-world zombie-survival series goes multiplatform, reaching PS5. Manage a fragile community, scavenge, and weigh permanent-death stakes in a hostile, systems-driven sandbox of the undead.
A standalone sequel to the branching teen-slasher hit, with a fresh cast. Expect the same cinematic, choice-driven “butterfly effect” horror where anyone can live — or die — by your decisions.
A first-person body-horror shooter that turned heads with its grotesque, hyper-detailed creature design. Visceral, stomach-churning atmosphere married to tense survival gunplay.
From Ikumi Nakamura's studio, a vibrant supernatural co-op action game. Hunt yokai across a fantastical near-future Japan with a slingshot-like “dango” grapple and a bold, characterful art style.
A story-focused open-world racer from former Forza Horizon developers. Aims to blend festival-style driving freedom with an actual narrative hook — coming to PS5 next year.
A surprise God of War spin-off shifting perspective to Faye — Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother — on a journey through what appears to be a mythological afterlife. Revealed June 2026; no window yet.
Naughty Dog's ambitious new sci-fi IP starring bounty hunter Jordan A. Mun, stranded on a quarantined planet ruled by a cult. Reported to be targeting 2027, but still undated.
Revealed at Summer Game Fest 2026 — a full remake of the cult classic survival-horror. Claire and Chris Redfield's island-and-Antarctica nightmare, rebuilt in the RE Engine. No date confirmed yet.
A stylish co-op live-service heist game pitting crews against the ultra-wealthy. Long in development at Sony's Haven Studios; still searching for a firm release window.
The next entry in ArenaNet's MMO franchise, confirmed for PS5 and PC. Promises a new world, momentum-based movement and a reworked combat system — but it's early days, with no date.
A striking single-player action-RPG set in a world blurring myth and machine. Console-bound for PS5 alongside PC; shown in trailers but still without a release window.
The long-awaited sequel to Telltale's noir Fables adaptation. Step back into Bigby Wolf's worn boots for another branching, choice-driven crime story on the seedy streets of Fabletown.
A follow-up to the Pixar-gorgeous Bridge of Spirits. Expect lush animated worlds, spirit-guiding Rot companions, and accessible action-adventure combat, built for PS5.

An original action-RPG from the Pokemon studio, set in a decayed far-future Japan. Bond with a wolf-like companion and fight through a ruined world in Game Freak's most ambitious non-Pokemon swing in years.
A cinematic action-adventure reimagining Arthurian legend in a ruined modern London. Summon spectral Knights of the Round Table to fight beside you against an invading otherworldly force.

The next mainline Persona, freshly announced with a tone said to echo Persona 3. The series' signature blend of social-sim daily life and stylish turn-based dungeon-crawling — platforms confirmed, date still to come.
